overview.title: Email Accounts
overview.description: Mailbox and alias counts across every domain.

queue.title: Postfix Mail Queue
queue.subtitle: Messages awaiting delivery, deferred, or placed on hold by an administrator.

errors.readFailed: Could not read the Postfix queue

serverSettings.title: Server-wide mail settings
serverSettings.subtitle: These apply to every domain on this server, above whatever a plan or a mailbox sets.
serverSettings.zeroNote: 0 means no limit. An empty size leaves whatever Postfix is already configured with.
serverSettings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.

primaryAddress.title: This server sends from {{ip}}
primaryAddress.notScanned: Not checked against any blocklist. A blocklist is queried by reversing an IPv4 address under its zone, so an IPv6-only address is never asked about.
primaryAddress.clean: Not listed on any configured blocklist.

filters.title: Sender allow and block lists
filters.subtitle: Scoring answers most cases; these are the instructions it cannot take. An entry applies to every domain on this server.
filters.addFailed: The entry could not be added.
filters.deleteFailed: The entry could not be removed.
filters.empty: No entries. Rspamd decides on its own.

pool.title: Outbound addresses
pool.subtitle: Every domain sends from the server's own address unless it is given one of these. Moving a noisy customer onto a separate address keeps their reputation off everyone else's mail.
pool.addFailed: The address could not be added.
pool.empty: No addresses. Everything sends from the server default.
pool.updateFailed: The address could not be updated.
pool.deleteFailed: The address could not be removed.
pool.confirmDelete: Remove {{ip}}? {{count}} domain(s) will go back to the server default.
